utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Alright, quick one today. Where are we on the settlement reconciliation job?

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: It's mostly there. I'll have the reconciliation job running against the staging ledger by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Good. And did the finance team ever sign off on the new fee schedule?

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: So finance have been really busy with quarter end, and there's a lot going on their side at the moment, you know how it is.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Right, but is it signed off?

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: I'll chase Priya today and get you a yes or no by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: One thing worth flagging — the sandbox keeps dropping connections under load, and we can't reproduce it locally.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: That sounds like it could block the pilot. Is it the connection pool?

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: Possibly. We haven't had time to dig in properly.

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: We had something similar last year and it turned out to be the load balancer idle timeout.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Okay — let's go with the phased rollout rather than the big-bang cutover. That's decided, I'll write it up.

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: Works for me. Do we need a rollback plan documented before the pilot?

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: I think we're all broadly aligned on risk appetite here, and the team has good instincts about this stuff.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: That's not really an answer, Tom. Do we need the document or not?

utterances.speaker: Tom
utterances.text: Yes. I'll draft the rollback plan and share it before the pilot starts.

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: Last thing, the vendor contract renewal is coming up and nobody owns it yet.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Noted. I'll take the vendor renewal and put it on next week's agenda.
